svg.aria-label: Project Argus. Stock market research dashboard. Pulls live Colombo Stock Exchange prices, order books and trade ticks, runs ARIMA forecasting, EWMA value-at-risk, drawdown, anomaly and regime models, combines them into one signal, and explains the result in plain language. Built with Python, FastAPI, React, Redis, Celery.
